Are you motivated by building meaningful connections with senior decision makers and uncovering new business opportunities?
Do you enjoy creating innovative outreach campaigns and driving measurable impact in a fast-paced sales environment?

As part of the Intellectual Property business unit, you will focus on identifying, engaging, and qualifying new business opportunities with prospective clients. You will play a critical role in generating high-value leads and enabling Enterprise Account Managers to succeed through well-prepared meetings and insights. This role emphasizes collaboration, curiosity, and delivering a positive prospect experience.

Create target lists of key points of contact within your portfolio of prospect accounts using Salesforce, LinkedIn, and ZoomInfo
Develop creative engagement campaigns that drive curiosity using email, HubSpot, LinkedIn, and phone
Discover new business opportunities by understanding a prospect’s interests, needs, and knowledge gaps through thoughtful conversations with senior decision makers
Respond to all marketing-generated leads in a professional and timely manner to identify opportunities
Deliver a consistent volume of meetings for Enterprise Account Managers, including detailed handover notes and briefings
Provide prospects with a high-quality experience and positive impression
Use Salesforce to record all activity and client interactions, ensuring data accuracy and quality

Strong written and verbal communication skills
Experience in B2B internal sales (approximately 12 months), ideally within SaaS, software, data analytics, or subscription-based solutions
Ability to confidently engage prospects by phone, establish credibility, and build rapport
Collaborative team mindset with strong interpersonal skills and resilience
Ability to work towards and achieve weekly and monthly targets
Interest in technology and innovation
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Salesforce
Familiarity with HubSpot and use of AI in sales processes
Ability to use metrics to monitor performance and understand results and drivers

SUMMARY OF DUTIES: Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an I can do that mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to, sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel.

Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: At least 1 year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required.

At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce.

As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results.

From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.
We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.
Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes.

Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.
AS A BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE YOU WILL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO:
Drive incremental sales pipeline and support existing customer requests
Work with the NeruaFlash Marketing and sales team to build and execute Campaigns with prospects, aligned to Salesforce and AWS sales motions
Follow up and create relationships with our AWS, Amazon Connect, and Salesforce Partner networks
Work closely with the sales team to manage the life cycle of a client and/or opportunity, and accurately track customer interactions, accounts, contacts, and updates in Salesforce
Use prospecting strategies to lead initial outreach to prospects
Identify the needs and challenges of the prospective customer
Schedule discovery meetings for sales representatives and prospects
Contribute to the ongoing development of the BDR program at NeuraFlash by introducing fresh and innovative ideas for engaging our customers and partners
Support Partner Communications by writing BASHOs and executing follow up on partner marketing emails
Log and track meetings and opportunities generated from BDR follow up in Salesforce
Be an impactful team member of the sales organization

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent relevant experience
Familiarity with Salesforce CRM and AWS
1-3 years of sales, business development, or inside sales experience (preferably in AWS, SaaS, or Salesforce ecosystem)
Hunter mentality and driven to find key stakeholders and new business opportunities
Competitive nature and confident demeanor- we want someone who is not afraid to speak with high level customers!
Passion for contributing to the growth and overall success of the business
Track record of being a high achiever in past organizations (school, past work experience, volunteering, athletics, etc.)
Required to work from our Boston office at least 3x/week

What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?
Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn’t possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it’s a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small.
Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don’t forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

We collaborate and innovate – pushing one another to transform not just Pacific Life , but the entire industry for the better. Why? Because it’s the right thing to do. Pacific Life is more than a job, it’s a career with purpose.

It’s a career where you have the support, balance, and resources to make a positive impact on the future – including your own. Pacific Life is seeking a skilled sales professional to support the growth of Broker Distribution within the Workforce Benefits organization.

You will play an integral part in Pacific Life ’s efforts to establish and grow a $1B revenue, profitable business in the Workforce Benefits market. This role is considered to be 100% remote, as travel is required, and our ideal candidate for this role will be based in the Maryland or DC marketplace .

As Workforce Benefits Sales Consultant - Broker Distribution you’ll play a key role in the startup and long-term success of this business by working with leaders in the Workforce Benefits division to meet established goals and objectives.

Your focus will be on building relationships, developing and executing broker specific strategies and driving growth toward sales goals within the Broker Distribution Channel. You are responsible for bringing our business to the broker market and meeting annual metrics-based sales objectives.

The role will align with other Workforce Benefits Distribution resources to educate the Broker and GA marketplace around Pacific Life ’s Group Benefits value proposition and meet collective sales goals. You will report directly to the RSM of Broker Distribution.

How You'll Help Move Us Forward Support the creation and execution of a strategy for Broker Distribution that helps meet new sales, retention, profitability and expense objectives. Meet annual sales goals as established by the RSM of Broker Distribution.

Partner with Workforce Benefits Distribution resources to deliver the Workforce Benefits story to the broker community. Continually work to strengthen, deepen, and grow broker relationships. Execute appropriate number of broker meetings per week with assigned brokers. Drive a pipeline of appropriate number of RFP’s per month.

Build and advance local broker relationships to drive sales and increase the Pacific Life brand in your market. Demonstrate proficiency in the group products sold by Pacific Life .

Maintain strong connections with underwriting, product, pricing, regulatory compliance, and actuarial pricing teams to ensure alignment on critical deliverables with your broker relationships. Utilize established and innovative approaches, tools and partners to enable efficient, deliberate and robust growth objectives.

Bring a customer-first mindset: prioritize customer and broker viewpoints in decision-making. Participate in ongoing industry and community activities to stay attuned to industry trends. Represent the company as needed with legislative platforms, industry events, community activities. Perform other job-related duties or special projects as required.

The Experience You Bring 5+ years’ experience in group benefits sales with an established presence in the broker marketplace College degree with concentration in business management, finance, or risk management or equivalent work experience is required.

The inclination to seek and analyze data from a variety of sources to support decisions and to align others with the organization's overall strategy. An entrepreneurial and creative approach to developing new, innovative ideas that will stretch the organization and push the boundaries within the industry.

Ability to seek opinions of others, process feedback and take smart risks. A high degree of integrity and able to act in a transparent and consistent manner while always taking into account what is best for the organization.

Self-reflective and aware of his/her own limitations; leads by example and drives the organization's performance with an attitude of continuous improvement. Mindset to enable breakthrough innovations and business models that create value for all stakeholders, continually challenging traditional approaches.

What Makes You Stand Out Strong performance orientation and drive for results. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to grasp complexities and perceive relationships among business and financial issues. Known for ability to respectfully and confidently collaborate and easily communicate with various stakeholders.

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Aetna, CVS Health is looking for top talent! The Telesales Representative is directly responsible for building a book of business via acquisition of new members using state-of-art lead generation platform supported by real time analytics.

Upon acquisition the Telesales Representative will own the member relationship throughout the year and will be the primary contact for member inquiries, including but not limited to, any questions related to plan benefits, product, and services offerings, as well as resolving any issues with respect to the utilization of the product.

The position will be a part of a high performing team with strong emphasis on personal and professional development and career growth.

Ensuring that the relevant information is captured in Customer Relationship Management system (CRM)

Contacting prospective members within the time limit outlined in the annual performance plan.
Achieving the member retention rate as outlined in the annual performance plan.
Highest levels of member satisfaction as measured by various member surveys and member retention rate.
Expert level understanding of products, services, and processes offered by the company.

QuickTeam helps US businesses grow by placing high-quality offshore talent — trained, vetted, and ready to work — at a fraction of the cost of hiring locally. We handle recruiting, onboarding, and client support from end to end. We're growing fast and looking for closers who want to be paid for what they actually produce. How this is different?

Most commission roles pay you once per deal and move on. This one keeps paying. Every month a client's virtual assistant is working, you earn. Close a client once, and that account generates income for as long as the VA stays — and our VAs typically stay for years. You're also not starting from scratch.

We have a dedicated lead specialist who continuously researches, qualifies, and contextualizes leads for you, so you're always working a warm pipeline. Your job is to close, not to build a list. What you get Warm, contextualized leads — a dedicated member of our team constantly builds and prepares your pipeline. You come in warm, not cold.

Recurring income — your commission is tied to hours billed by the VAs you place. Active placements mean monthly income, month after month, with no additional effort on your part. Long-term compounding upside — clients who stay for two or three years keep paying you the whole time. Your book of business grows and compounds.

Uncapped earnings in USD — no territory limits, no income ceiling. Full tools and access — CRM, dialer, email, and everything you need to work deals effectively. Backend handled for you — we manage recruiting, onboarding, and ongoing client delivery so you stay focused on selling.

What earnings look like Because commission is tied to hours worked rather than a flat placement fee, income compounds as your book grows. A modest base of a few active long-term clients generates meaningful recurring monthly income in USD — and that base keeps building as you close more.

The commission structure is competitive and discussed in full during the interview. How it works You apply and we walk you through the model, the leads, and the comp. We get you set up with tools and access. You start working leads and closing deals. You get paid — and keep getting paid every month your clients stay active.

Requirements What we're looking for Proven B2B sales or closing experience — staffing, services, SaaS, or similar preferred Exceptional spoken English is non-negotiable. This role is 100% phone-based selling to US business owners and decision makers.

Your voice, clarity, and confidence on a cold call is your product — if a prospect would hesitate for even a moment based on how you sound, this isn't the right fit. Candidates with a neutral, natural-sounding English accent are strongly preferred.

Comfortable working US EST/PST business hours Comfortable working leads by phone, email, and LinkedIn Self-motivated and disciplined — you don't need a manager over your shoulder Experience selling to or supporting US-based clients is a strong advantage Coachable, organized, and consistent in follow-up Hungry for uncapped, USD-denominated, performance-based income This role is not for Anyone expecting a base salary or guaranteed hourly pay People who need constant supervision or hand-holding Reps looking for a 9-to-5 with a predictable paycheck Originally posted on Himalayas

Candidates must be located within a reasonable commuting distance (approximately one hour) of a major or semi-major airport in the U.S. About Teton Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care- using real-time, multimodal AI to generate a digital twin of the resident and care environment.

Our proprietary computer vision system enables staff to automate documentation, proactively manage resident acuity, and streamline workflows across entire facilities.

From assisted living communities to hospital wards, our system delivers unprecedented access to real-time data insights, empowering providers with actionable intelligence to enhance decision-making and elevate care delivery.

With strong demand and a clear product-market fit, this role represents our fourth strategic sales hire in the U.S., focused on scaling our presence across the East Coast. It's a rare opportunity to drive market expansion and define how we win in one of our highest-potential regions.

Role Overview We’re looking for a Business Development Representative to help drive our U.S. growth. This position is heavily focused on outbound prospecting, with an emphasis on opening doors and building relationships at the executive and C-suite level in the senior living industry.

Candidates will need to bring both persistence and sophistication to their outreach- balancing high activity with thoughtful engagement of senior decision-makers.

This role offers direct exposure to enterprise sales cycles and close collaboration with leadership, making it an excellent opportunity for someone looking to advance their career in strategic business development. What You’ll Do Master Teton ’s platform, our commercial approach, and the senior living industry landscape.

Drive a high-volume outbound prospecting model (LinkedIn, email, and phone), using strategic, AI-driven methods to reach and engage senior executives and C-suites in senior living. Build and manage early-stage relationships with C-suite and executive stakeholders, preparing the ground for the Business Development Director.

Prepare outreach plans, activity schedules, and tailored messaging to meet pipeline targets. Support conferences and industry events by helping to set meetings and manage executive-level follow-up. Track activity, pipeline progress, and outreach performance in the CRM with attention to detail.

Stay current on competitors, industry trends, and market dynamics to sharpen prospecting strategy. Contribute to team projects and GTM initiatives as assigned. Always tie your work to Teton ’s mission of empowering caregivers and improving the quality of life for residents in senior living.

What You’ll Need 1–3 years of experience in business development, sales development, or a related outbound role, with a strong track record of achieving growth targets. Proven ability to engage and hold conversations with senior executives and C-suites Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

A self-starter mentality with excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. Comfortable with high-volume outbound prospecting while also contributing strategically to pipeline generation. Thrives in a high-activity sales environment with significant daily call volume.

Passionate about building a career in sales while making a meaningful impact in healthcare- helping caregivers work more efficiently and improving quality of life for residents in senior living communities. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Must have a valid driver’s license.

Candidates must reside in the U.S. and be within commuting distance to a major/semi-major airport. Why Join Teton Be part of a company transforming senior living care with cutting-edge technology. Gain direct exposure to enterprise deal cycles and executive-level sales strategy.

About The Opportunity
The Grubhub Sales Executive role is a great opportunity to leverage your sales skills to make an impact on the company’s rapid growth. Plus, you’ll be selling restaurant owners exactly what they already want: more business. Our current Sales Executive’s love the team events, contests, and of course the meal perks. This is the place to hone your sales skills, and make great money doing it.
You’ll be on the front lines of building Grubhub’s national restaurant partner network. You’ll research and consult with restaurants, contact and meet with decision makers, and show them how Grubhub can benefit their business. You’ll need to be resourceful, persuasive, determined, competitive, and have the ability to easily connect with people from all walks of life.
The Impact You Will Make
Discover Grubhub’s next wave of great local restaurants: We need you to engage the most wanted restaurants in your territory and help us discover those hidden gems our diners are craving.
Be the market expert: gather restaurant feedback, monitor competitor activity, marketing opportunities, and provide recommendations for improvement to management.
Consult with restaurant owners on the benefits of joining GrubHub and having access to our rapidly growing community of hungry diners. Identify needs and goals of the restaurant and demonstrate how Grubhub can help grow their business.
Conduct extensive cold calling (60+ dials per day), emailing, and social outreach to prospective decision makers.
Manage a territory and own the entire sales pipeline from prospecting to closing.
Secure appointments with prospective clients to uncover needs and present the value of a partnership.
Travel into the market to conduct in person sales pitches with merchant owners.
Exceed high-volume sales goals while working within a team environment.

Über Nelly
Wir bauen das AI-Driven Financial Operating System für das europäische Gesundheitswesen und lösen so die größten Herausforderungen für Patient:innen und Praxen. Damit schaffen wir, was keine Bank oder Softwareplattform bewältigen kann.

Unsere All-In-One Plattform verwandelt chaotische administrative Prozesse in intelligente, automatisierte Arbeitsabläufe, von der Patientenbetreuung über die Abrechnung bis hin zu Zahlungen der nächsten Generation. Denn wir sind davon überzeugt: Das Gesundheitswesen sollte weniger mit Papierkram und mehr mit Menschen zu tun haben.
Warum? Europa ist mit einem massiven Mangel an medizinischen Fachkräften konfrontiert. Wenn wir die Arbeitsweise von Praxen nicht überdenken, wird das System nicht mithalten können. Mit unserer Series B Finanzierung in Höhe von über 50 Millionen Euro von Weltklasse-Investoren setzen wir unsere Vision in die Tat um.
Was dich erwartet: Wir arbeiten mit dem besten Team und geben gemeinsam jeden Tag alles. Wir setzen auf Talent Density, weil außergewöhnliche Menschen alle um sie herum besser machen. Mit Hauptsitz in Opfikon bei Zürich beschäftigt Implenia europaweit über 8 000 Mitarbeitende (FTE) und erzielte im Jahr 2025 einen Umsatz von CHF 3,5 Mrd. Weitere Informationen unter implenia.com
Zur Verstärkung ihres **Teams Real Estate Transaction in unserer Division -Buildings**- **sucht Jelena Radovic** eine proaktive und unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit als **Akquisiteur Grundstücke & Entwicklungspotenziale (w/m/d), 50-100%.**
Mit deinem Gespür für Chancen, deinem Netzwerk und deinem unternehmerischen Denken identifizierst du attraktive Entwicklungsareale und Grundstücke für die zukünftigen Projekte von Implenia. Dein zukünftiger **Arbeitsort ist Opfikon**, dein **Marktgebiet umfasst schwerpunktmässig den Aargau sowie die Nordwestschweiz und die Region Zürich.**
### Das bewegst du ###
* Du identifizierst und akquirierst aktiv Grundstücke, Areale und Entwicklungspotenziale mit Schwerpunkt im Kanton Aargau sowie ergänzend in der Nordwestschweiz und der Region Zürich
* Du gehst proaktiv auf Grundeigentümerinnen, Landwirtinnen und Gemeinden zu und baust langfristige Beziehungen zu relevanten Marktteilnehmer\*innen auf
* Du pflegst und erweiterst dein persönliches Netzwerk zu Gemeindebehörden, Makler\*innen, Architekturbüros, Notariaten, Treuhändern und weiteren Entscheidungsträgern
* Du bewertest potenzielle Akquisitionsobjekte in einer ersten Einschätzung und erkennst frühzeitig Chancen für Immobilien- und Arealentwicklungen
* Du übergibst qualifizierte Opportunitäten an das Transaction-Team und unterstützt bei Bedarf die Aufbereitung von Akquisitionscases gemeinsam mit internen und externen Fachspezialist\*innen
### Deshalb gelingt es dir ###
* Du hast eine kaufmännische Ausbildung oder kommst aus dem Planungssektor und bringst **mindestens****drei Jahre Erfahrung in der Immobilienbranche** mit

* Mit deiner kommunikativen und gewinnenden Art gelingt es dir, nachhaltige Beziehungen zu Grundeigentümerinnen, Gemeinden und weiteren Marktteilnehmerinnen aufzubauen
* Idealerweise verfügst du über zusätzliche Kenntnisse in den Bereichen **Immobilienbewertung, Immobilientransaktionen, Real Estate Management, Raumplanung oder Bewilligungswesen **
* Du kommunizierst stilsicher in **Deutsch, verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse** und bringst idealerweise bereits ein Netzwerk im **Aargau** mit
### Das bieten wir dir ###
* Ein multikulturelles Arbeitsumfeld mit der Chance, eine lebenswerte Zukunft mitzugestalten
* Modernste Technologien und einen zeitgemässen Arbeitsplatz bei einem nachhaltigen Unternehmen
* Ein Unternehmen, das Talente und die Weiterbildung seiner Mitarbeitenden fördert
* Die Sicherheit eines finanziell gesunden, breit aufgestellten Konzerns mit starken Wurzeln in der Schweiz

* 5 Wochen Ferien und 9 bezahlte Brückentage

Business Development Representative
Turn strong, growing inbound demand into qualified pipeline — supported by targeted ABX outbound and the industry’s biggest events
There are a lot of security companies out there, but no one is doing what Nucleus is doing: giving security teams the ability to run the most effective vulnerability and exposure management program possible. Some of the largest enterprises and government agencies in the world run on our platform, and we’re growing fast. Top-tier venture funding, an amazing team who will fight beside you to accomplish the impossible, great benefits, and fully remote.
Here’s the good news about this seat: our inbound demand is strong and growing. Your primary job is to work it well — respond fast, qualify sharply, and turn real interest into meetings your AE counterparts are glad to take. You’ll back that up with targeted outbound into named accounts as part of our account-based (ABX) program, and you’ll represent Nucleus face to face at the industry’s biggest security events a few times a year.
Why this role exists
This is a new seat created by growth — driven in large part by inbound volume we want to convert better and faster. Your individual output is visible and it matters. You’ll also be joining a leader whose real strength is developing top-performing BDRs: structured onboarding, weekly coaching and mock calls, and a documented track record of promoting reps into account executive, solutions engineering, customer success, and marketing roles.

Own inbound — this is the priority. Be the first, fast, credible response to the people raising their hands: demo requests, content and webinar leads, event follow-up, and trial interest. Qualify with real discovery — need, timing, environment, decision process — and convert genuine interest into meetings that stick. Speed and judgment both matter: our buyers are busy, and the first good conversation usually wins.
Support the ABX program with targeted outbound. Outbound here is deliberate, not a numbers game. You’ll work a defined set of high-value named accounts alongside Marketing and your AEs — using intent and account signals to time your outreach — so outbound reinforces the accounts we’ve collectively decided matter most.
Personalize everything, and use AI to do it well. Our buyers are technical and busy. You’ll write outreach and follow-up that sounds like a person who understands their world — and you’ll use AI tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) every day to research faster and sharpen your messaging.
Run a clean process. Manage inbound routing, accounts, and follow-up in Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Outreach, and Gong — and partner closely with your AEs and Marketing to act on campaign signals fast.
Represent Nucleus at our biggest events. A few times a year, our BDRs are the front line at RSAC, Black Hat, the Gartner Security & Risk Management Summit, and other key events — proactively engaging people in and around our booth, qualifying on the spot, and booking high-quality meetings. Expect roughly 3–4 events a year, plus our annual company and sales kickoff.
Your first 90 days
We’ve run this playbook before, and we don’t leave ramp to chance:
First 30 days
By 60 days
By 90 days
Structured onboarding and product training. Learn our market, ICP, and the vulnerability and exposure management problems our buyers face. Shadow calls, run mock calls, and start handling live inbound with close coaching.
Owning inbound response and qualification for your patch, with outbound sequences live into your named ABX accounts. Weekly 1:1s and email-writing sessions to sharpen your craft.
Fully ramped and holding your own number — converting inbound into qualified meetings, supporting ABX outbound, and confident enough in the material to represent Nucleus in front of a security buyer.

2–4+ years in sales or business development — BDR/SDR, inside sales, or another customer-facing role. Experience handling real inbound volume with a high qualification bar is especially relevant.
Sharp qualification instincts. You can tell a genuine opportunity from a tire-kicker quickly, and you protect your AEs’ calendars without dropping real interest on the floor.
Outbound capability too. You can build and run a thoughtful, targeted sequence into a named account when it matters — not just work a queue.
Cybersecurity or technical SaaS experience preferred. Holding a credible conversation with a security buyer is a meaningful advantage.
Strong communication. Concise and credible in writing and on the phone with senior technical people.
Comfortable in person. You genuinely enjoy meeting people face to face and can open a conversation with a stranger on a busy expo floor.
AI-fluent. Using AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, and Claude in your daily workflow is a requirement, not a bonus.
Tech-savvy. Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Gong, Slack, Teams, and Zoom.
Curious, resilient, and coachable. You want to be coached — this is a team where you’ll get real feedback and be expected to use it.
Nice to have: selling into U.S. Federal, Defense, or State & Local government; an established cybersecurity network; a bachelor’s or associate degree.
If you have less experience than the range above but can show real results and genuine curiosity about security, we’d still like to hear from you. We hire for trajectory and coachability, not just years on a resume.
Why you should be excited
The mission. We automate enterprise vulnerability and exposure management so security teams can prioritize and mitigate risk, at scale — working toward a world where remediation outpaces exploitation.
Warm demand to work with. You’re not starting from zero. Inbound interest is real and growing, and your job is to make the most of it.
The career path. A launchpad, run by a leader who builds and promotes top performers into AE, solutions engineering, customer success, and marketing roles.
Nucleus believes “work is people”, and when our people succeed, our company succeeds.

· Neukundenakquise \& Marktentwicklung:
Aufbau und Entwicklung eines neuen Kundenstamms im Projektgeschäft (Elektroplaner, Systemintegratoren, spezialisierte Installateure)
· Spezifikations\- \& Ausschreibungsplatzierung:
Platzierung von Hager Systemen in Ausschreibungen inklusive Erstellung von Leistungsverzeichnissen, Konzepten und Angeboten
· Technische Lösungskonzepte:
Entwicklung von Integrationslösungen für Gebäudeautomation, Energiemonitoring und BMS\-Anbindungen
· Netzwerkaufbau:
Aufbau und Pflege eines regionalen Partnernetzwerks, insbesondere im Bereich Systemintegratoren
· Technische Unterstützung:
Beratung und Unterstützung von Planern und Integratoren bei komplexen Applikationen und Systemfragen
· Schulungen \& Präsentationen:
Durchführung von Workshops und Produkttrainings (z.B. KNX Secure, Energiemonitoring)
· CRM\- \& Pipeline\-Management:
Strukturierte Dokumentation von Projekten, Verkaufschancen und Kundenaktivitäten
Dein Profil
· Technische Ausbildung \& Weiterbildung:
Elektrotechnische Berufsausbildung (EFZ) sowie Weiterbildung HF/FH in Gebäudeautomation, Elektrotechnik oder Smart Building
· KNX\-Expertise:
Zertifizierte KNX\-Ausbildung (zwingend) sowie mindestens 3\-5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im KNX\-Umfeld

Fundierte Kenntnisse im Energiemonitoring (z.B. Wandler\- und Zählertechnik) sowie Erfahrung mit Modbus, BACnet oder DALI/DALI 2 und deren Integration in BMS

Professionelles Auftreten sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations\- und Verhandlungsstärke im B2B\-Umfeld

Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Lösungen verständlich und überzeugend darzustellen (online und vor Ort)

Hohe Serviceorientierung und Freude an nachhaltiger Kundenbetreuung

You build your own view of the market, test what works, and feed what you learn directly back into how we sell. If you think in terms of pipeline health rather than call counts, and want real input into the commercial strategy of an early-stage company, this is that seat.
For this particular position we are looking for someone who can work from our Berlin office in a hybrid setup.

Build and own your outbound strategy for the healthcare segment, from account research through to a qualified meeting
Run a sustained, high-intensity outreach cadence across calls, email and LinkedIn, supported daily by AI tooling that handles the groundwork so your time goes into judgement, not admin
Qualify opportunities against clear criteria and hand off meetings that are genuinely ready for our Account Executives
Keep a clean, accurate record of every conversation and outcome in our CRM, your data shapes decisions beyond your own pipeline
Feed customer and market signal directly into our GTM strategy , your read on the market changes how we approach it, not just how you execute it
Track industry shifts and translate them into sharper positioning over time
